tools.name: count_leads
tools.description: Exact count of matching businesses, with how many have a verified email, an owner's name or no website, and the top cities. Free. Use this first to answer 'how many'.

tools.name: search_leads
tools.description: Up to 25 matching businesses. Phone, email, owner surname and website are masked unless the caller owns the lead. Free.

tools.name: parse_query
tools.description: What a plain-English lead search means (niche, city, state, filters) without running it. Free.

tools.name: list_niches
tools.description: Every niche id with the leads, states and verified emails in stock. Niches with 0 leads can be requested on the site. Free.

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: Lead counts per state (or per city when a state is given), optionally for one niche, so you can avoid empty searches. Free.

tools.name: get_sample
tools.description: Up to 5 unmasked rows for one niche in one city. 3 different samples a day per account (per IP without a key); asking again for the same one replays it. Free.

tools.name: request_build
tools.description: Ask for a niche and place that count_leads shows as empty or thin. Stores the request (deduped, a few a day per caller) and returns how many people asked for the same list. Does not build a list on the spot. Free.

tools.name: quote_export
tools.description: Price an export before taking it: rows, credits, the daily allowance left and a quote_token valid 10 minutes. Free. Show the user say_to_user and wait for an explicit yes before export_leads. Up to 1000 rows per MCP export.

tools.name: export_leads
tools.description: Take the leads in a quote and return them as CSV text. Spends credits exactly like the web export, and each lead is charged once ever. Never call without the user's explicit confirmation of the quoted price.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_leads, list_niches · Public sink: count_leads, search_leads.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_leads, list_niches · Public sink: count_leads, search_leads

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
